description: This file is a Java source file defining a class 'MongoDbResource' for managing embedded MongoDB instances in test environments. It handles starting and stopping the database, configuration, and health checks, and is intended for use in Java-based test code that interacts with MongoDB.

classes.name: MongoDbResource
classes.description: A utility class for managing an embedded MongoDB instance during tests, including starting, stopping, and health check operations.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the MongoDB instance by invoking the lifecycle method 'before'.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the MongoDB instance by invoking the lifecycle method 'after'.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Configures and starts the embedded MongoDB process, with environment variable checks for proxy and port settings.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Stops the running MongoDB process and cleans up resources.

methods.name: isHealthy
methods.description: Checks whether the MongoDB process started successfully and is running.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number on which MongoDB is listening.

methods.name: getBindIp
methods.description: Returns the IP address on which MongoDB is bound.

methods.name: findFreePort
methods.description: Finds and returns a free network port for MongoDB to bind to.
